source_locator: Clark County results viewer, election 13P (2013 Municipal Primary), Official Election Results, contest Mayor of Henderson, Total row
verification_note: Mayor of Henderson, 155 of 155 precincts, total 17537 votes. Arthur A. 'Andy' Hafen 9618 (54.84 percent) is a majority. Rick Workman 6520 is second. Other candidates: Hamilton 390, Robinson 186, Sakura 241, Scala 459, Simmons 123. The 06/04/2013 municipal general (13G) has no Mayor of Henderson contest, which fits the charter rule that a majority winner is elected at the primary. The results viewer is a live page that needs form selections (election 13P, category Official Election Results). The page does not state a certification date. The rule in force in 2013 and 2017 is shown by the Legislative Counsel's Digest of 2015 Statutes of Nevada, chapter 295 (SB 5), pages 1479-1480, at https://www.leg.state.nv.us/Statutes/78th2015/Stats201514.html. The digest says that for most charter cities, including Henderson (Henderson City Charter 5.010), existing law in 2015 provided that a candidate with a majority of votes in the primary city election is declared elected and is not placed on the general city ballot. That act amended only the Carson City charter, so the Henderson rule stayed the same through 2017. The current text of NRS 293C.175 (June even-year primaries) applies only from 2019 and later and is not used as the rule for 2013 or 2017. The Henderson charter text itself was not opened (the city site returned HTTP 403 and no charter page was found on the legislature site); the rule rests on the digest.
